open_decision: Whether an unidentified owner whose age equals stale_after exactly is recovered (the laws only cover age strictly above or strictly below).
input: {pidKnown := false, alive := false, reused := false, age := some 5, staleAfter := 5}
result_a: true (remove the lock file; ref uses a >= staleAfter)
result_b: false (keep the lock file; a rule that uses a > staleAfter)
reason: For a known pid the laws fix the result in every case. For an unknown pid they fix only age > stale_after and age < stale_after, so the equal boundary (and age = none) is free. Two rules that differ only there both pass every law.
